pages.transcript:
COLLISIONS
Momentum $p = mv$ (vector, unit kg m/s). Newton 2nd law: $F = \Delta p / \Delta t$.
Law of conservation of momentum: if no external force, total momentum before = total momentum after. $m_1u_1 + m_2u_2 = m_1v_1 + m_2v_2$.
Eg. gun recoil: $m_g v_g = -m_b v_b$.

Elastic collision: momentum AND KE conserved. Equal masses -> exchange velocities.
Inelastic: only momentum conserved, KE lost as heat/sound. Perfectly inelastic: bodies stick, $v = (m_1u_1+m_2u_2)/(m_1+m_2)$.
Coefficient of restitution $e = (v_2 - v_1)/(u_1 - u_2)$, $0 \le e \le 1$. Ball dropped: $e = \sqrt{h_1/h_0}$.

Displacement vs distance: displacement is a vector (shortest path), distance scalar.
Velocity $v = \Delta x/\Delta t$; acceleration $a = \Delta v / \Delta t$.
Equations of motion (const a): $v = u + at$, $s = ut + \tfrac12 at^2$, $v^2 = u^2 + 2as$.
Free fall: $a = g = 9.8\ m/s^2$ downwards. Slope of x-t graph = velocity, slope of v-t graph = acceleration, area under v-t = displacement.

1 mole = $6.022 \times 10^{23}$ particles (Avogadro number $N_A$).
Molar mass = mass of 1 mol in g/mol (numerically = molecular mass in u). Number of moles $n = m/M$.
At STP 1 mol gas = 22.4 L. Empirical formula = simplest whole number ratio; molecular formula = n x empirical.
Limiting reagent: reactant used up first, decides amount of product.

Cell theory (Schleiden, Schwann, Virchow - omnis cellula e cellula).
Prokaryotic: no nuclear membrane, 70S ribosomes, e.g. bacteria. Eukaryotic: membrane bound nucleus and organelles, 80S ribosomes.
Mitochondria = powerhouse, site of aerobic respiration, has own DNA. Chloroplast: photosynthesis, in plants. Cell membrane: fluid mosaic model (Singer & Nicolson).
